alignments.note: Postpositive δέ realized by the verse-initial *Now*.

Article governing a substantival adjective takes the supplied nominal *gifts* under rule 102, headed on it; rule 17's generic-noun clause is scoped to anarthrous Greek. Aligning *gifts* to πνευματικῶν and leaving the article unrepresented remains defensible.
Substantival adjective keeps the bare *spiritual*, the supplied noun going to its article under rule 102.
Vocative, anarthrous, no supplied address word.
Inflected verb takes its English subject and lexical verb; head on *would* under rule 9.
Infinitive rendered by the causative frame *have … ignorant*; head on the lexical predicate *ignorant* under rule 17, discontinuous under rule 15.
Expressed accusative subject of the infinitive.
